scope: Solar/shadow capture coherence and fail-closed evidence integrity for the Built-in Render Pipeline benchmark.
priorityRationale: Lighting/shadows/reflections carries 15 Visual Fidelity points with a hard minimum of 13 and inconsistent sun/shadow direction is an automatic critical FAIL. Before adding more speculative visible assets, this run audited whether the deterministic midsummer sun and the high-quality shadow settings remain the same state through scene rebuild, save and Camera.Render.

audit.initialFinding: QualityBlockEnvironmentContext.ApplyToDirectionalLight historically wrote SummerSun shadowBias=0.04 and shadowNormalBias=0.28, while QualityBlockShadowStabilityUpgrade required 0.025 and 0.38. This showed two independent writers for the same capture-critical light state.
audit.selfCorrection: Follow-up source inspection found QualityBlockShadowStabilitySaveGate already subscribed to benchmark sceneSaving and reapplied/validated the 0.025/0.38 shadow-stability state. Therefore the initial hypothesis was narrowed: the mismatch was a transient writer inconsistency before save, not evidence that the final saved native-4K capture necessarily used 0.04/0.28. The implementation retained only changes that improve the invariant beyond the existing save repair.
remainingRisksBeforeThisRun: The solar application entry point and shadow-stability pass could temporarily disagree about the same SummerSun state.
The old shadow validator identified SummerSun but did not fail merely because another enabled directional key existed.
There was no independent MainCamera pre-cull rejection of a second directional key or post-save shadow-state drift immediately before Camera.Render.
Solar geometry was deterministic in code but was not bound to an explicit machine-readable expected elevation/azimuth/shadow-length reference for capture QA.

sourceMath.interpretation: Southwest source sun, approximately northeast horizontal shadow direction. These values are source-math evidence only and do not clear pixel-level shadow defects.

implemented: Moved the complete deterministic solar plus StableFit/4-cascade/VeryHigh shadow/camera/LOD state into runtime-safe QualityBlockSolarShadowRuntimeContract and made every QualityBlockEnvironmentContext.ApplyToDirectionalLight call use it.

Added exact-one-active-directional enforcement. The only allowed enabled active directional light is SummerSun, which must also be RenderSettings.sun and match the calculated solar ray, intensity and color temperature.

Added QualityBlockSolarShadowPreRenderGuard on the physical environment context. It subscribes to Camera.onPreCull and validates the benchmark MainCamera state immediately before culling; configuration drift or a contradictory second key throws before authoritative rendering can proceed.
Added QualityBlockSolarShadowCaptureCoherenceQA with structured source-math, exact shadow-setting, guard-binding and critical-fail validation. It awards zero Visual Fidelity points.

Added QualityBlockSolarShadowCaptureSaveGate. Primitive scratch scene saves remain allowed before a physical environment context exists; contextualized benchmark saves fail unless the contract and bound guard validate.
Strengthened QualityBlockShadowStabilityUpgrade so its validator fails on more than one active directional light and requires the new machine-readable solar/shadow contract.
Added solar_shadow_capture_coherence_contract.json and synchronized environment_lighting_contract.json and shadow_stability_contract.json with the same capture authority and non-scoring policy.

Added a lookdev SVG showing plan/elevation solar geometry, expected 58.11 degree elevation, 244.23 degree azimuth, 0.622 m/m shadow ratio, locked shadow state, pre-cull guard and the 92/100 evidence gate.

selfAuditFixes.issue: The first version of QualityBlockSolarShadowCaptureCoherenceQA used x.gameObject.scene while iterating GameObject values in RequireSummerSun, which would not compile.
selfAuditFixes.resolution: Corrected immediately in commit 5d5fa9416dde2382518161ec0c68526f01b0896e to use x.scene.IsValid().

selfAuditFixes.issue: Initial audit wording overstated the old per-light bias mismatch as an unguarded final-capture defect.
selfAuditFixes.resolution: Inspected QualityBlockShadowStabilitySaveGate, confirmed it already repaired/validated canonical shadow values on benchmark save, and updated contracts/readiness to describe the actual residual risk: competing writers plus missing exact-one-key and pre-cull enforcement.

verification.method: GitHub source/static inspection and Unity 6 Scripting API verification only; no local or hosted Unity editor was available.
unityDocumentationFactsUsed: Camera.onPreCull is called before a Camera culls the scene in the Built-in Render Pipeline.
Camera.Render manually renders a camera and invokes its pre-cull/pre-render/post-render lifecycle and image effects.

implementationReadiness.reason: The remaining seven readiness points are reserved for actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime verification, which is still unavailable.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Lighting/shadows/reflections: reduces the risk of inconsistent key direction, contradictory directional sources and shadow-state drift; actual category points remain unawarded until rendered evidence.

Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: ensures StableFit cascades, high LOD bias and MSAA policy are reapplied with the solar state and fail-closed at pre-cull; actual shimmer/pop still requires moving-image evidence.
Cinematic image quality/composition/color/exposure: locks deterministic midsummer sun intensity/color temperature before filmic capture; highlight/exposure quality remains pixel-review only.
Evidence integrity: configuration/source math can reject invalid capture state but cannot produce a Visual Fidelity PASS without real 3840x2160 frames and 100% crops.
nextBlocker: A real Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner. At first availability, stop speculative expansion and run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet. Confirm the solar/shadow save gate and MainCamera pre-cull guard execute, then inspect hero/ground_contact, oblique/construction_depth and grazing/tree_shadow_contact at 100% for actual southwest-sun/northeast-shadow coherence, contact detachment/acne, contradictory highlights, light leaks and cascade shimmer. Fix any critical rendered defect before scoring.
